headline: Earnings grow strongly as margin widens and dividend rises
summary_short: Citizens' Q3 2026 net income was $636M (+29% y/y) and diluted EPS $1.41 (+34% y/y, +8% q/q); net interest margin rose to 3.19% and ROTCE to 15.1%.
summary_long: Revenue of $2.32B grew 10% y/y with expenses up only 4%, giving 5.3% positive operating leverage. Net interest income rose 3% q/q as margin widened 2 bps; fees slipped 1% on lower mortgage and capital markets, offset by record wealth. Net charge-offs held at 0.37% and the provision fell to $125M. CET1 was 10.5%. Tangible book value per share fell 6.6% q/q to $35.78. The board raised the quarterly dividend 13% to $0.52 and lifted buyback capacity to $1.95B.
confidence_notes: The 8-K cover has no EX-99 exhibit in its folder index; the earnings release document in the same filing was used. Net interest margin shown is the FTE figure. Tangible book value per share drop is as reported in the release.

drivers.explanation: Up 2.7% q/q with the margin up 2 bps; up 13% y/y with the margin 19 bps higher.
Pre-provision profit grew 18.6% y/y and the provision for credit losses fell, with Private Bank contributing $0.16 to EPS.
CEO said the bank remains confident in its positioning and outlook for Q4 and 2027.
